meta.title: feat: enhance text generation panel with execution time and token usage display
meta.body_summary: Add execution time and token usage display to the text generation panel in the Giselle workflow designer UI.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex added execution time and token usage display to generation panel; merged after shige approval and non-blocking bot suggestions on type safety and styling.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 130 changed lines across 4 files, this is a small edit by absolute volume. It fits a small‑step UI enhancement performance PR and is consistent with the successful, low‑friction merge.

review_details.concern_detail: Bots flagged unsafe type casting as unknown and missing totalTokens computation; also suggested replacing non‑standard Tailwind class size-[12px] with w-[12px] h-[12px].
review_details.performance_claim: Add UI visibility for execution time and token usage to improve performance monitoring and cost awareness.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Simple front‑end UI enhancement with schema changes within existing architecture; agent delivered feature, minor bot feedback on type safety but no human changes requested; merged quickly.

detection_detail.code_reading: Copilot and CodeRabbit bots performed static analysis, flagging type safety and consistency issues.
detection_detail.ci_auto: Vercel preview deployments and bot reviews served as automated checks; no CI failures.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Screenshots and testing instructions provide manual verification path; no quantitative performance metrics are needed for this visibility feature.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions reported; merge proceeded without issues.

core_change_summary.description: Added GenerationUsage schema with prompt/completion/total tokens, recorded token usage in generateText, and added execution time and token display in generation panel using TimerIcon, ArrowUpIcon, ArrowDownIcon with locale‑formatted numbers.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: generation-view.tsx only added blank lines for formatting.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: Added GenerationUsage schema and usage recording in generateText.
Second commit: Added token usage display (prompt, completion tokens) in generation panel with icons.
Third commit: Removed total tokens display from UI, kept prompt and completion tokens; adjusted icon layout.
Fourth commit: Added execution time display with formatExecutionTime helper.
Fifth commit: Adjusted execution time formatting to milliseconds for < 1 minute.

review_signals.summary: Suggested computing totalTokens as promptTokens + completionTokens in generateText.
Suggested adding transform to schema to automatically compute totalTokens.
Suggested using w-[12px] h-[12px] instead of size-[12px] for icon sizing.
Flagged unsafe casting and suggested type narrowing for accessing usage properties.
Provided PR overview with no blocking comments; 3 low‑confidence suggestions suppressed.
Posted 1 actionable comment (unsafe casting) and additional comments; CHILL profile.

collaboration_trajectory: Codex agent added usage schema and UI display in iterative commits.
Copilot and CodeRabbit bots reviewed with type safety and styling suggestions but no blockers.
